physicalAnchorReview.method: Median of lower-shell scanline centers in bottom quarter, excluding bottom 7px matte guard; root at shell base. Candidate measurements reviewed against the 32-source overlay before activation.

Manual per-pose visual measurement of the ventral cervical/anterior-trunk root, projected vertically onto the complete source lower bound including extraction guard. Source images inspected at original dimensions with a 50px cell-relative QA grid, then each proposed landmark and floor projection inspected again with temporary cyan markers. No source image edits, no inferred root from tail bounding-box center.

Manually observed posterior hip articulation; root x is its vertical projection. Ground y is complete recovered pose padded bottom (three-pixel extraction guard), except explicitly identified suspended poses using inspected grounded peers in the same source row. Tail, head and claw extrema never determine root x. Cropped offsets include negative source spill bounds.
